articles.title: Luke Dashjr removed as Bitcoin BIP editor after controversial BIP-110 fork stalls
articles.snippet: Dashjr said he is taking a sabbatical from his role as chair and chief technology officer of mining pool Ocean.

articles.title: Luke Dashjr removed as Bitcoin Improvement Proposal editor
articles.snippet: Luke Dashjr lost his BIP editor privileges after developers raised concerns over his role in BIP 110 and its stalled minority fork.

articles.title: Luke Dashjr Removed as BIP Editor After BIP-110 Bitcoin Fork Stalls
articles.snippet: Supporters of the soft fork he championed split onto their own chain on Saturday, where it mined two blocks in eight hours and stopped.
